name: 2 Peter
lede: The sixty-first book of the Bible, in full: Peter's second letter, written near his death — partakers of the divine nature, in your faith supply virtue, the putting off of my tabernacle cometh swiftly, eyewitnesses of his majesty on the holy mount, a lamp shining in a dark place until the day-star arise, false teachers, Noah, Sodom and righteous Lot, Balaam and the dumb ass, where is the promise of his coming?, one day as a thousand years, the day of the Lord as a thief, new heavens and a new earth, our beloved brother Paul, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: Until the Day Dawn
books.blurb: Simon Peter, to them that have obtained a like precious faith: partakers of the divine nature; in your faith supply virtue, and in your virtue knowledge, … and in your brotherly kindness love; the putting off of my tabernacle cometh swiftly; we were eyewitnesses of his majesty, This is my beloved Son, in the holy mount; a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawn; false teachers; God spared not the ancient world, but preserved Noah; Sodom and Gomorrah turned into ashes, righteous Lot delivered; the way of Balaam, a dumb ass spake; mockers: where is the promise of his coming?; one day is with the Lord as a thousand years; the day of the Lord will come as a thief; new heavens and a new earth; our beloved brother Paul; grow in grace.
